summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Customer Portal features including auth, profile, purchases, points, rewards, redemption, payment initiation, and referral system. Backend: 19/19 tests passed (100%). Frontend: All portal pages working correctly with proper navigation and data display.
passed_tests: Backend: POST /api/portal/register - creates new customer with referral code
Backend: POST /api/portal/login - authenticates with phone + password
Backend: GET /api/portal/profile - returns name, phone, points, referral_code, referral_count
Backend: GET /api/portal/purchases - returns purchase history
Backend: GET /api/portal/points - returns points balance and history
Backend: GET /api/portal/rewards - returns reward tiers with can_redeem flag
Backend: POST /api/portal/redeem - validates insufficient points correctly
Backend: POST /api/portal/payment/initiate - returns PayFast form data with signature
Backend: GET /api/portal/referral - returns referral code, link, and referral list
Backend: Referral bonus - both referrer and referred have 5 bonus points
Backend: POST /api/vouchers/upload-csv - admin CSV voucher upload works
Frontend: /portal/login loads with login/register toggle
Frontend: /portal dashboard shows stats cards (Points, Purchases, Redeemed, Referrals)
Frontend: /portal dashboard shows quick actions (Buy Plan, Redeem Rewards, Refer a Friend)
Frontend: /portal/buy shows all 11 plans with prices and points earned indicator
Frontend: /portal/rewards shows points balance (5 pts), 11 reward tiers with progress bars
Frontend: /portal/referral shows referral code (REF-D7CDAF), share link, referral list
Frontend: /portal/history shows purchase history table with Date, Plan, Amount, Voucher Code, Type, Status
Frontend: Sidebar navigation works correctly across all portal pages
Frontend: Logout redirects to login page
seed_data_creation: Two portal customers exist: Test Customer (referrer) and Friend User (referred). Both have 5 bonus points from referral. Test voucher codes added via CSV upload: TEST-CSV-001, TEST-CSV-002, TEST-CSV-003 (1_day plan).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Customer Portal fully tested. Portal auth uses separate JWT with role=portal_customer. Points system: 1pt per R10 spent, 5pts referral bonus. Reward tiers range from 10pts (1 Day Pass) to 270pts (4 Devices Monthly). PayFast payment cannot be fully E2E tested without real transaction. Redemption creates payment record with payment_type=redemption and amount=0.

notes.portal_auth: Portal uses phone + password authentication. JWT contains role=portal_customer and customer_id.
notes.points_system: 1 point per R10 spent. Referral bonus: 5 points to BOTH referrer and referred.
notes.reward_tiers: 11 tiers from 10pts (1 Day Pass R10) to 270pts (4 Devices Monthly R300). Redemption assigns voucher from pool.
notes.referral_system: Each customer gets unique referral code (REF-XXXXXX). Referral link: /portal/register?ref=CODE
notes.payment_integration: PayFast in LIVE mode. Payment initiate returns form_fields for redirect. ITN callback awards points on COMPLETE.
